author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,

You can Blow up the Old laggy Hub with TNT!
some of you already know this, but I just want to inform some more ppl!

First of all: Big thanks to Vetzen! He set up the all of this!

How to blow it up: Do /server Mapdev and join with /join. You'll get TNT, redstone, water, etc.

If you want you can post some pictures of the destruction you made >:)

http://imgur.com/a/eU1zn
